guard: A user-mode chat session connects: the callout mints a chat principal no endpoint capability and never resolves it as an actor grant.
why: A chat session's row lives in its own space and is never an actor grant, so no caller policy can name it. Resolving its endpoint caller rights through the actor ledger finds no grant and denies the connect, after admission has already succeeded.

mutations.name: C1 the callout resolves a chat principal's endpoint caller rights as an actor grant
mutations.expectRed: a user-mode `cotal chat --stdio` session connects as its own chat principal
mutations.cell: a user-mode `cotal chat --stdio` session connects as its own chat principal
